integrity.claim_basis: symbolic term-function proof with an independent finite regression checker
integrity.source_date_basis: arXiv v1 public timestamp for the motivating source

scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the displayed four-element nonassociative ring, not for arbitrary finite prime rings.
The finite checker covers only n=1,2,3 and is supplementary to the symbolic proof.
Older clone or identity-theory literature may contain an equivalent formulation under another presentation; this remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact free-algebra growth for Olshanskii's four-element prime ring
